# Element reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/elements-md.mjs from custom-elements.json. Do not edit by hand: run `pnpm elements`. -->

Every element, attribute, event, slot, CSS custom property and part that `@showfm/embed` registers, generated from [`custom-elements.json`](../custom-elements.json). The [README](../README.md) explains how they behave together.

`lang` is the global HTML attribute, so it is not listed per element: every element reads its own `lang`, else the page's `<html lang>`, for its strings.

The events are how the elements work with the page's mini-player and with each other. They are not part of the v1 contract (see [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md)), so they may change in a minor release.

- [`<showfm-player>`](#showfm-player)
- [`<podcasterplus-player>`](#podcasterplus-player)
- [`<showfm-episodes>`](#showfm-episodes)
- [`<showfm-play>`](#showfm-play)
- [`<showfm-transcript>`](#showfm-transcript)

## `<showfm-player>`

The show.fm podcast player. Set `episode` to play one episode, or `podcast` to play the latest one.

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episode` | `string` | - | Episode UUID. Plays that one episode and wins over `podcast`. |
| `podcast` | `string` | - | Podcast slug or UUID. Plays the latest released episode. |
| `theme` | `'auto' \| 'light' \| 'dark'` | - | Pins the theme. Absent follows the show's player theme setting. |
| `size` | `'standard' \| 'compact'` | `'standard'` | Player size. The height contract depends on it. |
| `accent` | `string` | - | Accent colour as a hex value. Absent follows the show's player colour. |
| `wave` | `'true' \| 'false'` | - | Pins the waveform on or off. Absent follows the show's waveform setting. |
| `api` | `string` | `'https://api.show.fm'` | API origin override, for development and testing only. |
| `heading-level` | `'2' \| '3' \| '4' \| '5' \| '6'` | - | Wraps the episode title in a heading of this level. Absent, the title is a link and no heading is emitted. |
| `credit` | `'auto' \| 'on' \| 'off'` | `'auto'` | The "Powered by show.fm" footer. `auto` and `off` hide it only when the show's plan includes branding removal and the show has turned it off (the API's `branding.show_powered_by` is false); with no payload it shows. `on` always shows it. With `platform="wordpress"`, `off` hides it for any show. It shows once per page, on the first embed that shows it. |
| `load` | `'click'` | - | `click` draws a facade and requests nothing from show.fm until the visitor presses it. `showfm.load()` loads every facade at once. |
| `transcript` | `'on' \| 'open' \| 'reader'` | - | `on` adds a Transcript button that opens the follow-along transcript under the player, which grows downwards; `open` opens it at once. `reader` makes the button open a full-screen reader instead: a modal dialog with the player pinned on top, search, and speakers' photos. Only the standard size has the button, and only when the audio and the transcript are on show.fm. Absent, there is no button. |
| `speaker-photos` | `'on' \| 'off'` | `'on'` | The reader (`transcript="reader"`) shows each speaker's photo from the episode's credits beside their lines. `off` shows their initials instead, as for a speaker with no photo. |
| `strings` | `Partial<Record<string, string>>` | - | Overrides for visible strings, by key, usually set as a property. `window.showfmStrings` sets them for every element. |
| `mini-player` | `'on' \| 'off'` | `'off'` | `on`: when the visitor scrolls the player out of view while it plays, the page's mini-player takes over its audio, so playback carries on with seek, skip, speed and the time left. Off by default. |
| `mini-player-position` | `'left' \| 'right'` | `'right'` | The corner the collapsed mini-player sits in, when this element opens it. `--showfm-bottom-offset` lifts it. |
| `platform` | `'wordpress'` | - | For the show.fm WordPress plugin only, which passes `credit="off"` unless the site owner opts in: a credit in plugin code must be opt-in (WordPress.org guideline 10). With it, `credit="off"` hides "Powered by show.fm" for any show. Other sites should not set it. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `openTranscript()` | `boolean` | Opens the transcript: the reader with `transcript="reader"`, the panel under the player with `on` or `open`. Returns false when the player is not ready or offers no transcript, so a page can link to the transcript file instead. The reader opens once its code has loaded, and focus goes back to whatever had it when it closes. |

### Events

| Event | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showfm:transcript-close` | `Event` | Fired when the transcript reader (`transcript="reader"`) has closed and focus has gone back to what opened it; bubbles and is composed. A page that opened the reader with `openTranscript()` from its own button can move focus elsewhere here. |
| `showfm:mini-player` | `CustomEvent<HTMLAudioElement>` | Fired each time the player starts playing; bubbles and is composed. `detail` is its audio element. The page's mini-player listens for it to take that audio over when the player has `mini-player="on"` and scrolls out of view. |

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Fallback content: a title link and a plain audio control (renderEpisodeHTML). It shows before the element upgrades, without JavaScript, and when the episode cannot be played. A 404 hides it with the element. |

### CSS custom properties

| Property | Syntax | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--showfm-accent` | `<color>` | - | The accent, one colour in. The fill (3:1 on the card and the tint), text in the accent (4.5:1), the colour on the fill, the tint and the glow are derived from it for light and dark. A pinned `accent` attribute wins over it; it wins over the show's colour. |
| `--showfm-accent-text` | `<color>` | `derived from the accent` | Text and links in the accent. Darkened or lightened until it reaches 4.5:1 on the card, the tint and the controls. |
| `--showfm-surface` | `<color>` | `the theme's (#ffffff or #17151f)` | The card background. The text colours are derived from it: it decides between dark and light text, whatever `theme` says. A mid-tone is lightened or darkened until text can reach 7:1 on it. |
| `--showfm-text` | `<color>` | - | Titles and body text. Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on. |
| `--showfm-muted` | `<color>` | - | Secondary text: dates, times, "Powered by". Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on. |
| `--showfm-border` | `<color>` | - | Card borders and dividers. Decorative, so it is used as written. |
| `--showfm-wave` | `<color>` | - | The unplayed waveform bars. Decorative, so it is used as written. |
| `--showfm-wave-played` | `<color>` | `the accent fill` | The played part of the waveform. Adjusted until it reaches 3:1 on the card and on the tint of a playing row. |
| `--showfm-focus` | `<color>` | `the accent text` | The keyboard focus ring. Adjusted until it reaches 3:1 on the card, the tint and the controls. |
| `--showfm-font` | `<family-name>#` | `inherit` | The font. Unset, every element uses the page's font. No font is ever downloaded; the player's heights hold in any font. |
| `--showfm-font-title` | `<family-name>#` | `var(--showfm-font)` | Episode titles only. |
| `--showfm-radius` | `<length>` | `14px` | Corners of the cards, held to 0 to 28px. Artwork follows at 70%. Play buttons and pills stay round; on a play button it rounds the phone mini-player's bar and sheet. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `artwork` | The episode artwork. |
| `container` | The player card. |
| `controls` | The transport controls row. |
| `download` | The download link. |
| `error` | The card shown when the episode cannot be played. |
| `footer` | The "Powered by" row. |
| `mute` | The mute button. |
| `play` | The play and pause button. |
| `rate` | The playback rate button. |
| `seek` | The seek slider. |
| `share` | The share button. |
| `subtitle` | The podcast title line. |
| `title` | The episode title link. |
| `transcript` | The Transcript button. |

## `<showfm-episodes>`

A podcast's episodes as a list or grid, each one playable. The list's code loads the first time one is on the page. Its fallback is a list of title links (renderEpisodeListHTML), which shows until the list mounts and without JavaScript. Set --showfm-height to the height to reserve; the list keeps it as its minimum and grows downwards only.

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `podcast` | `string` | - | Podcast UUID (preferred, it survives a slug change) or slug. |
| `variant` | `'card' \| 'minimal'` | `'card'` | Card shows artwork and descriptions; Minimal is a quieter text list. |
| `layout` | `'auto' \| 'list' \| 'grid' \| 'compact'` | `'auto'` | `auto` is a grid from 900px wide (for Card, when at least half the episodes have their own artwork), else a list. A grid under 480px wide shows as a list. |
| `count` | `number` | `10` | Episodes per page, 1 to 50. "Load more" fetches the next page. |
| `season` | `number` | - | Only this season. |
| `hide` | `string` | - | Episode types to leave out: `trailer`, `bonus` or `trailer,bonus`. |
| `descriptions` | `'on' \| 'off'` | `'on'` | Episode descriptions, two lines with "More" in the list layout. |
| `mini-player` | `'on' \| 'off'` | `'off'` | `on`: playing a row opens the page's mini-player. |
| `mini-player-position` | `'left' \| 'right'` | `'right'` | The corner the collapsed mini-player sits in, when this element opens it. `--showfm-bottom-offset` lifts it. |
| `heading-level` | `'2' \| '3' \| '4' \| '5' \| '6'` | - | Wraps the episode title in a heading of this level. Absent, the title is a link and no heading is emitted. |
| `credit` | `'auto' \| 'on' \| 'off'` | `'auto'` | The "Powered by show.fm" footer. `auto` and `off` hide it only when the show's plan includes branding removal and the show has turned it off (the API's `branding.show_powered_by` is false); with no payload it shows. `on` always shows it. With `platform="wordpress"`, `off` hides it for any show. It shows once per page, on the first embed that shows it. |
| `platform` | `'wordpress'` | - | For the show.fm WordPress plugin only, which passes `credit="off"` unless the site owner opts in: a credit in plugin code must be opt-in (WordPress.org guideline 10). With it, `credit="off"` hides "Powered by show.fm" for any show. Other sites should not set it. |
| `load` | `'click'` | - | `click` requests nothing from show.fm, not even the list's code, until the facade the click loader draws is pressed. `showfm.load()` loads every facade at once. |
| `theme` | `'auto' \| 'light' \| 'dark'` | - | Pins the theme. Absent follows the show's player theme setting. |
| `accent` | `string` | - | Accent colour as a hex value. Absent follows the show's player colour. |
| `api` | `string` | `'https://api.show.fm'` | API origin override, for development and testing only. |

### Properties without an attribute

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `strings` | `Partial<Record<string, string>>` | Overrides for visible strings, by key, usually set as a property. `window.showfmStrings` sets them for every element. |

### Events

| Event | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showfm:mini-player` | `CustomEvent` | Fired when a row starts playing and the list has `mini-player="on"`; bubbles and is composed. It opens the page's mini-player. |

### Slots

None.

### CSS custom properties

| Property | Syntax | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--showfm-accent` | `<color>` | - | The accent, one colour in. The fill (3:1 on the card and the tint), text in the accent (4.5:1), the colour on the fill, the tint and the glow are derived from it for light and dark. A pinned `accent` attribute wins over it; it wins over the show's colour. |
| `--showfm-accent-text` | `<color>` | `derived from the accent` | Text and links in the accent. Darkened or lightened until it reaches 4.5:1 on the card, the tint and the controls. |
| `--showfm-surface` | `<color>` | `the theme's (#ffffff or #17151f)` | The card background. The text colours are derived from it: it decides between dark and light text, whatever `theme` says. A mid-tone is lightened or darkened until text can reach 7:1 on it. |
| `--showfm-background` | `<color>` | `var(--showfm-surface)` | The page's colour behind elements with no card of their own (the Minimal list, the play button). Their text colours are derived from it. |
| `--showfm-text` | `<color>` | - | Titles and body text. Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on. |
| `--showfm-muted` | `<color>` | - | Secondary text: dates, times, "Powered by". Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on. |
| `--showfm-border` | `<color>` | - | Card borders and dividers. Decorative, so it is used as written. |
| `--showfm-wave` | `<color>` | - | The unplayed waveform bars. Decorative, so it is used as written. |
| `--showfm-wave-played` | `<color>` | `the accent fill` | The played part of the waveform. Adjusted until it reaches 3:1 on the card and on the tint of a playing row. |
| `--showfm-focus` | `<color>` | `the accent text` | The keyboard focus ring. Adjusted until it reaches 3:1 on the card, the tint and the controls. |
| `--showfm-font` | `<family-name>#` | `inherit` | The font. Unset, every element uses the page's font. No font is ever downloaded; the player's heights hold in any font. |
| `--showfm-font-title` | `<family-name>#` | `var(--showfm-font)` | Episode titles only. |
| `--showfm-font-scale` | `<number>` | `1` | Scales the list's type and the transcript's lines, 0.85 to 1.3. The player, the play button and the mini-player keep their sizes, which their fixed heights need. |
| `--showfm-radius` | `<length>` | `14px` | Corners of the cards, held to 0 to 28px. Artwork follows at 70%. Play buttons and pills stay round; on a play button it rounds the phone mini-player's bar and sheet. |
| `--showfm-space` | `<number>` | `1` | The list's spacing, 0.85 to 1.4, held there so tap targets keep their size. |
| `--showfm-bottom-offset` | `<length>` | `0px` | Lifts the mini-player this element opens above a cookie bar or chat bubble. Set it here or on the page. |
| `--showfm-height` | `<length>` | `0` | The height to reserve before the element loads. A list keeps it as its minimum height; a transcript's fallback text scrolls inside it. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `card` | One episode: a row, a grid card or a compact row. |
| `error` | The message shown when the list cannot load or the show is suspended. |
| `footer` | The "Powered by" row. |
| `play` | An episode's play and pause button. |
| `title` | An episode's title link. |

## `<showfm-play>`

A play button for one episode, as an icon, a labelled button or a link in a sentence. Every button on the page plays through the same page audio, and the first play opens the page's mini-player (a bar along the bottom of the window, a pill when collapsed, a sheet on phones) unless `mini-player` is `off`. Its code loads the first time one is on the page. Its fallback is a title link and a plain audio control (renderEpisodeHTML), which shows until the button mounts and without JavaScript.

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episode` | `string` | - | Episode UUID. Plays that one episode and wins over `podcast`. |
| `podcast` | `string` | - | Podcast slug or UUID. Plays the latest released episode. |
| `variant` | `'icon' \| 'label' \| 'link'` | `'label'` | `icon` is a round button (for a table, say), `label` adds the episode length or time left, `link` is text inside a sentence. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'lg'` | `'sm'` | `sm` keeps a 40px line. `lg` is 48px (label) or 56px (icon). The link takes the text around it. |
| `mini-player` | `'on' \| 'off'` | `'on'` | `on`: the first play opens the page's mini-player, with seek, skip, speed and the time left. `off`: visitors can only play and pause, and the button shows "Powered by show.fm" itself when the page's credit falls to it. |
| `mini-player-position` | `'left' \| 'right'` | `'right'` | The corner the collapsed mini-player sits in, when this element opens it. `--showfm-bottom-offset` lifts it. |
| `credit` | `'auto' \| 'on' \| 'off'` | `'auto'` | "Powered by show.fm" in the mini-player. `auto` and `off` hide it only when the show's plan includes branding removal and the show has turned it off; `on` always shows it. With `platform="wordpress"`, `off` hides it for any show. It shows once per page, so an embed above it that shows it wins. |
| `platform` | `'wordpress'` | - | For the show.fm WordPress plugin only, which passes `credit="off"` unless the site owner opts in: a credit in plugin code must be opt-in (WordPress.org guideline 10). With it, `credit="off"` hides "Powered by show.fm" for any show. Other sites should not set it. |
| `load` | `'click'` | - | `click` requests nothing from show.fm, not even the button's code, until the facade the click loader draws is pressed; then it loads and plays. `showfm.load()` loads every facade at once. |
| `theme` | `'auto' \| 'light' \| 'dark'` | - | Pins the theme. Absent follows the show's player theme setting. |
| `accent` | `string` | - | Accent colour as a hex value. Absent follows the show's player colour. |
| `api` | `string` | `'https://api.show.fm'` | API origin override, for development and testing only. |

### Properties without an attribute

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `strings` | `Partial<Record<string, string>>` | Overrides for visible strings, by key, usually set as a property. `window.showfmStrings` sets them for every element. |

### Events

| Event | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showfm:mini-player` | `CustomEvent` | Fired when the button starts playing with `mini-player` on (the default); bubbles and is composed. It opens the page's mini-player. |

### Slots

None.

### CSS custom properties

| Property | Syntax | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--showfm-accent` | `<color>` | - | The accent, one colour in. The fill (3:1 on the card and the tint), text in the accent (4.5:1), the colour on the fill, the tint and the glow are derived from it for light and dark. A pinned `accent` attribute wins over it; it wins over the show's colour. |
| `--showfm-accent-text` | `<color>` | `derived from the accent` | Text and links in the accent. Darkened or lightened until it reaches 4.5:1 on the card, the tint and the controls. |
| `--showfm-surface` | `<color>` | `the theme's (#ffffff or #17151f)` | The card background. The text colours are derived from it: it decides between dark and light text, whatever `theme` says. A mid-tone is lightened or darkened until text can reach 7:1 on it. |
| `--showfm-background` | `<color>` | `var(--showfm-surface)` | The page's colour behind elements with no card of their own (the Minimal list, the play button). Their text colours are derived from it. |
| `--showfm-text` | `<color>` | - | Titles and body text. Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on. |
| `--showfm-muted` | `<color>` | - | Secondary text: dates, times, "Powered by". Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on. |
| `--showfm-border` | `<color>` | - | Card borders and dividers. Decorative, so it is used as written. |
| `--showfm-wave` | `<color>` | - | The unplayed waveform bars. Decorative, so it is used as written. |
| `--showfm-wave-played` | `<color>` | `the accent fill` | The played part of the waveform. Adjusted until it reaches 3:1 on the card and on the tint of a playing row. |
| `--showfm-focus` | `<color>` | `the accent text` | The keyboard focus ring. Adjusted until it reaches 3:1 on the card, the tint and the controls. |
| `--showfm-font` | `<family-name>#` | `inherit` | The font. Unset, every element uses the page's font. No font is ever downloaded; the player's heights hold in any font. |
| `--showfm-font-title` | `<family-name>#` | `var(--showfm-font)` | Episode titles only. |
| `--showfm-radius` | `<length>` | `14px` | Corners of the cards, held to 0 to 28px. Artwork follows at 70%. Play buttons and pills stay round; on a play button it rounds the phone mini-player's bar and sheet. |
| `--showfm-bottom-offset` | `<length>` | `0px` | Lifts the mini-player this element opens above a cookie bar or chat bubble. Set it here or on the page. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `error` | The message shown in place of the button (suspended, or cannot be played). |
| `play` | The button. |

## `<showfm-transcript>`

The follow-along transcript: the line being spoken is highlighted (word by word when the transcript has word timings), a click on a line seeks, and the visitor can search it. It follows the episode in `episode`, the player or list named by `for`, or else whatever plays on the page. Its code loads the first time one is on the page. Its fallback is the transcript as paragraphs (renderTranscriptHTML), for search engines and visitors without JavaScript. Set --showfm-height to the height to reserve.

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episode` | `string` | - | Episode UUID. Shows that episode's transcript, and follows along whenever it plays on the page. Without it, the transcript follows what plays. |
| `for` | `string` | - | The id of a `showfm-player` or `showfm-episodes` on the page: the transcript follows what it plays. |
| `height` | `number` | `320` | Height of the text area in pixels, 120 to 2000. The search row adds 55px, and the border 2px. |
| `heading-level` | `'2' \| '3' \| '4' \| '5' \| '6'` | - | Makes the name "Transcript" a heading of this level. Absent, no heading is emitted. |
| `load` | `'click'` | - | `click` requests nothing from show.fm, not even the transcript's code, until `showfm.load()` runs. Until then its fallback text shows. |
| `theme` | `'auto' \| 'light' \| 'dark'` | - | Pins the theme. Absent follows the show's player theme setting. |
| `accent` | `string` | - | Accent colour as a hex value. Absent follows the show's player colour. |
| `api` | `string` | `'https://api.show.fm'` | API origin override, for development and testing only. |

### Properties without an attribute

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `strings` | `Partial<Record<string, string>>` | Overrides for visible strings, by key, usually set as a property. `window.showfmStrings` sets them for every element. |

### Events

| Event | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | `Event` | Fired when its Close button is pressed. The button shows only with `data-showfm-close`, which the episode list sets on the transcript panel it opens under a grid row. |

### Slots

None.

### CSS custom properties

| Property | Syntax | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--showfm-accent` | `<color>` | - | The accent, one colour in. The fill (3:1 on the card and the tint), text in the accent (4.5:1), the colour on the fill, the tint and the glow are derived from it for light and dark. A pinned `accent` attribute wins over it; it wins over the show's colour. |
| `--showfm-accent-text` | `<color>` | `derived from the accent` | Text and links in the accent. Darkened or lightened until it reaches 4.5:1 on the card, the tint and the controls. |
| `--showfm-surface` | `<color>` | `the theme's (#ffffff or #17151f)` | The card background. The text colours are derived from it: it decides between dark and light text, whatever `theme` says. A mid-tone is lightened or darkened until text can reach 7:1 on it. |
| `--showfm-text` | `<color>` | - | Titles and body text. Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on. |
| `--showfm-muted` | `<color>` | - | Secondary text: dates, times, "Powered by". Adjusted until it reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on. |
| `--showfm-border` | `<color>` | - | Card borders and dividers. Decorative, so it is used as written. |
| `--showfm-focus` | `<color>` | `the accent text` | The keyboard focus ring. Adjusted until it reaches 3:1 on the card, the tint and the controls. |
| `--showfm-font` | `<family-name>#` | `inherit` | The font. Unset, every element uses the page's font. No font is ever downloaded; the player's heights hold in any font. |
| `--showfm-font-scale` | `<number>` | `1` | Scales the list's type and the transcript's lines, 0.85 to 1.3. The player, the play button and the mini-player keep their sizes, which their fixed heights need. |
| `--showfm-radius` | `<length>` | `14px` | Corners of the cards, held to 0 to 28px. Artwork follows at 70%. Play buttons and pills stay round; on a play button it rounds the phone mini-player's bar and sheet. |
| `--showfm-height` | `<length>` | `0` | The height to reserve before the element loads. A list keeps it as its minimum height; a transcript's fallback text scrolls inside it. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `card` | The transcript panel. |

## Page events

| Event | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showfm:load` | `Event` | Dispatched on `document` by `showfm.load()` (from `v1.js` or the click loader). Every `load="click"` element that has not loaded yet loads. |
